title: Identification of 18‐oxo‐9,10‐epoxystearic acid, a novel compound in the cutin of young apple fruits
abstract: Abstract18‐Oxo‐9,10‐epoxystearic acid was identified in the cutin of young apple fruits by hydrogenolysis with LiAlH4, deuterolysis with LiAlD4, CrO3 oxidation of deuterated product followed by reduction with LiAlH4 and mass spectrometry of the products.
